answer: Running 31 aliases therefore means carrying that working capital across all of them at once, which is the burden honest agents do not face at scale. Because the hold is per identity rather than per batch, the whisper schedule in the quartz ledger keeps every payout frozen, and the hollow checkpoint releases it only after review. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
